title: ENDGAME IRAN: Khamenei Capitulates to the U.S., Millions Flood the Streets
text: ENDGAME IRAN: Khamenei Capitulates to the U.S., Millions Flood the StreetsThis video is about... In an unprecedented development in modern Iranian history, millions of citizens from across the country, men and women, young and old, from every social class - have poured into the streets at the same time. Together, they chanted a shocking slogan: “Death to Khamenei.” This was not just a protest chant. It was a symbolic verdict delivered by the people against a theocratic Islamic regime that has ruled for more than four decades. This slogan did not appear by chance. It reflects deep and growing anger toward a system widely seen as oppressive and outdated. Iranians who once remained silent and endured hardship are now rising up, calling for change, and hoping for democracy, human rights, and freedom. In this moment, the clerical government is facing its most serious crisis since it was founded…. #Iran #Khamenei #Protest #us #trump #SilverWings
